versions.name: RXV2-0.9.493-rescue-bar
versions.notes: Transmitter channels: Rescue gets the same blue bar as Bank/Rates showing its OFF and ON zones (drag the ends; ON above the middle); 'Bank (PID profile)' renamed 'Bank (Profile)'.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.492-title-fits
versions.notes: Page titles on back-arrow pages sit below the button row at full width - no more 'Switch / es' squeeze.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.491-arm-stays
versions.notes: The Arm switch card no longer offers Remove - Rotorflight requires an arm switch.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.490-uniform-switch-cards
versions.notes: Bank and Rates selector cards now share the exact layout of the other switch cards - same labelled pickers, bar and Save.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.489-tx-on-note
versions.notes: Switches and Transmitter-channels pages now remind you to have the transmitter ON - the live red tick needs it.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.488-stateful-zones
versions.notes: Switch-card zone edges now live purely in memory - the number boxes are gone completely, not just hidden (less complexity down the road).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.487-simpler-switches
versions.notes: Switch cards on the Switches page lose the two microsecond number boxes - just the bar, the draggable ends and the live red tick.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.486-one-true-back
versions.notes: Model-name chip fits again (width only narrows on pages with the back arrow); every page's embedded back button removed - the floating arrow now knows its own destination.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.485-buttons-restored
versions.notes: Front screen's Rotorflight and Black box buttons are back (the floating-back change had hidden them by mistake); only genuine 'Back to ...' buttons are now hidden.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.484-floating-back
versions.notes: A floating back arrow now sits beside the home button on every sub-page - one level up without scrolling; the old bottom 'Back to ...' buttons are gone.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.483-control-sense
versions.notes: Travel extents gains a Control sense area (Malcolm): tick to reverse Aileron, Elevator or Collective - one control at a time, no negative numbers, servos untouched; applies on Save, no reboot.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.482-collective-reverse
versions.notes: Travel extents gains a 'Collective reversed' switch (Malcolm's new build): flips collective alone via the mixer input's sign - roll, pitch and the servos untouched; applies immediately, no reboot.
